title: Dishwasher
prompt: a built-in dishwasher: open the door, load plates, add a tablet, start; it fills, sprays, drains, dries; see-through shows the inlet valve, circulation pump, spray arms, heater, filter, drain pump and detergent dispenser
blurb: Load four plates and follow water through a dishwasher's fill, wash, rinse, drain and heated drying cycle.
